title: Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) Rate Card: Plan Prices, Terms and Billing Frequencies
content:
Stratton Bay resells six Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) plans under Microsoft new-commerce terms. This rate card lists, for every plan, the price per license, the commitment terms offered and the billing frequencies each term allows.

## Price and term schedule

| Plan | Annual price (USD per license per month) | Surcharge when a P1Y or P3Y term is billed monthly | Premium for a P1M term | Terms offered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 6.00 | 5.0 percent | 20.0 percent | P1M, P1Y |
| Microsoft 365 F3 | 8.00 | 5.0 percent | 20.0 percent | P1M, P1Y |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 12.50 | 5.0 percent | 20.0 percent | P1M, P1Y |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 22.00 | 5.0 percent | 20.0 percent | P1M, P1Y |
| Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) | 33.75 | 5.0 percent | 20.0 percent | P1M, P1Y, P3Y |
| Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | 54.75 | 5.0 percent | 20.0 percent | P1M, P1Y, P3Y |

What each column means:

- **Annual price**: the price per license per month on a P1Y or P3Y term billed annually, in USD per license per month.
- **Surcharge**: the surcharge on the annual price when a P1Y or P3Y term is billed monthly, in percent.
- **Premium**: the premium on the annual price for a P1M term, in percent.
- **Terms offered**: the commitment terms offered, from P1M (one month), P1Y (one year) and P3Y (three years).

## Billing frequency and price terms

| Plan | Billing frequencies on P1Y and P3Y | Billing frequency of P1M | Price locked for the term | Three-year price lock | Price at renewal | Proration basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | monthly, annual | monthly | yes | no | current price list | daily over the billing cycle |
| Microsoft 365 F3 | monthly, annual | monthly | yes | no | current price list | daily over the billing cycle |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | monthly, annual | monthly | yes | no | current price list | daily over the billing cycle |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | monthly, annual | monthly | yes | no | current price list | daily over the billing cycle |
| Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) | monthly, annual | monthly | yes | yes | current price list | daily over the billing cycle |
| Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | monthly, annual | monthly | yes | yes | current price list | daily over the billing cycle |

- **Price locked for the term**: whether the subscription's unit price is fixed for the whole term.
- **Three-year price lock**: whether a P3Y term keeps its unit price for all three years. Only the two plans that offer P3Y carry it.
- **Price at renewal**: the price applied at renewal, which on every plan is the current price list.
- **Proration basis**: how partial-cycle charges and refunds are computed, which on every plan is daily over the billing cycle.

## Reading the rate card

- A P1M term is billed monthly on every plan. Only P1Y and P3Y terms may be billed either monthly or annually.
- P3Y appears only on Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) and Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams). No other plan can be placed on a three-year term.
- The surcharge and the premium are both percentages of the plan's annual price. The surcharge applies to a P1Y or P3Y term billed monthly. The premium applies to a P1M term.
